这条命令需要管理员权限，确认后会弹出 Windows UAC 提权窗口。: This command requires administrator privileges. Windows will show a UAC prompt after confirmation.
本次会话内，同类操作不再询问: Allow similar operations for this session
查看这台电脑的系统信息，包括 CPU、内存和磁盘使用情况。: Show this PC’s system information, including CPU, memory, and disk usage.
哪些进程最占内存？: Which processes use the most memory?
列出当前占用内存最多的 15 个进程。: List the 15 processes currently using the most memory.
检查当前有哪些开机自启动项，说明哪些可能是多余的。: Check the current startup apps and explain which ones may be unnecessary.
列出当前用户环境变量 PATH 的每一项目录，并标注哪些路径不存在。: List every directory in the current user’s PATH and flag paths that do not exist.
需要我做什么？: What can I help you do?
我可以直接操作这台 Windows：执行 PowerShell、读写注册表、管理: I can work directly on this Windows PC: run PowerShell, read and write the registry, manage environment variables, and inspect or stop processes.
告诉我要做什么，例如：把用户 PATH 里的 D:\\tools 去掉: Tell me what to do, e.g. remove D:\tools from my user PATH
Enter 发送 · Shift+Enter 换行: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
输入自定义模型名后回车: Enter a custom model name and press Enter
名称、Base URL、默认模型不能为空: Name, Base URL, and default model are required
连接成功，但没有返回模型列表: Connected, but no models were returned
留空则不修改已保存的 Key: Leave blank to keep the saved key
Key 保存在 Windows 凭据管理器，不会写入数据库或日志。: Keys are stored in Windows Credential Manager, never in the database or logs.
支持任意 OpenAI 兼容接口，Base URL 填到域名或 /v1 即可（例: Supports OpenAI-compatible APIs. Use a domain or /v1 as the Base URL (e.g. https://api.openai.com or http://localhost:11434/v1).
达到上限后会停下，等待你继续发消息。: At the limit, execution pauses until you send another message.
越低越稳定；系统管理场景建议 0.2 - 0.4。: Lower values are more predictable. For system administration, 0.2–0.4 is recommended.
当前为「提醒模式」：只读和低风险命令直接执行；危险与高危操作会暂停并等待你确认。: In confirmation mode, read-only and low-risk commands run directly. Dangerous and critical operations pause for your approval. There is no fixed blocklist; approved commands run with your permissions.
本机 Windows 超级管理员智能体。Rust + Tauri 内核，命令与系: A local Windows administration agent powered by Rust and Tauri. Commands and system operations run on your machine.
所有执行记录保存在本地 SQLite 的 tool_runs 表中；API Ke: Execution records are stored locally in the SQLite tool_runs table. API keys are stored in Windows Credential Manager.
当前为标准权限，需要时会对单条命令请求 UAC 提权: Running with standard privileges. Individual commands request UAC elevation when needed.
语言切换立即生效，并会自动保存。: Language changes apply immediately and are saved automatically.
删除供应商「{{name}}」？已保存的 API Key 也会一并删除。: Delete provider “{{name}}”? Its saved API key will also be deleted.
还没有配置 {{name}} 的 API Key，点这里去设置: No API key configured for {{name}}. Click to open settings.
默认使用用户家目录下的 Documents\\WinAgent。修改后用于后续备: Defaults to Documents\WinAgent in your home directory. Changes apply to future backups; existing files are not moved.
请先停止会话再删除: Stop this chat before deleting it
